population: All 2675 good-quality held-out responses, 450 complete source groups; uniform response weights; original labels/flags and fitting fixed.
uncertainty: 10000 paired complete-source draws: preserve original 2000, append 8000 multinomial draws with seed 20261019. Joint max-standardized bootstrap bands over all capped error/work contrast coordinates, modeled-correction sensitivity coordinates and validation-tuning contrasts. Propagate bands through nonnegative concave basis coefficients to all common geometric utility/cost parameters.
correction_assumptions: Each flagged erroneous unit is fixed with p; each flagged correct unit is corrupted with h. Fixed flags; unflagged units unchanged. Unit-independent and response-coupled outcomes have identical marginal rates and expected error counts. Parameters are sensitivity assumptions, not fitted repair rates.

validation_tuning.candidate_rules: 101 validation-score quantiles plus original F1 threshold plus no-action option; choose maximum validation value, break ties by fewer flags then higher threshold. Evaluate only after choosing cutoff. No test labels used for selection.

kill_criteria: Mismatched response/source identity or count bounds
Failure to reproduce frozen means and three geometric losses
Incorrect source-weight hash or incomplete source resampling
Failure of exact correction moments or profile reconstruction
Invalid validation/test split or fitted scorer mismatch
scope: Conditional inference for frozen score/flag policies and declared correction/work proxies. No neural or human correction experiment; no population interpretation of a unique crossing when bands allow absence/multiplicity.

tuning_robustness_extension.reason: Resolve the concrete dependence of aggressive ideal-correction policies on assumed repair success and harm.
tuning_robustness_extension.settings: Apply both already declared inference p/h cases and both dependence models to validation tuning; assess transported ideal policies too.
tuning_robustness_extension.selection: All correction settings and utility prices remain those specified before execution; no cases chosen by observed sign.
